source_basis.copyright_boundary: Do not copy article media, prompts, scripts, or private project data. Extract workflow mechanisms only.

workflow.reuse_rule: Every reused asset is referenced by asset_id and SHA-256; no silent regeneration of an already approved asset.

workflow.rule: Local repair creates a child branch and preserves the parent; it never clones an entire episode to repair one shot.
Use explicit blocking for multi-actor or special-angle shots; text-only placement is marked UNKNOWN, not assumed correct.
Agnes may be used for isolated trials or controlled takes; provider completion never equals director PASS.
Only repeated, hash-backed failure patterns become experience; a single opinion does not rewrite routing.

quality_invariants: One shot has one primary dramatic action or dialogue beat.
Long actions are split at preparation, peak/impact, and recovery boundaries.
Character, wardrobe, scene, prop, spatial blocking, and camera references are explicit.
A failed child branch preserves the parent and its evidence.
Free Zone research renders remain candidates until explicit hash-bound admission.
